input.subject: [E30] Duplicate Payment
input.body: Dear Team, I was charged twice while ordering an Xbox Wireless Controller, but only one order was placed successfully. My first payment was made using a different bank account, and I then placed the order successfully using another account. The order ID is BM189438. I would like to request a refund for the first transaction. Please check the duplicate payment and let me know when I can expect the refund.

Scope 1.1 This Cancellation Policy (“Cancellation Policy”) governs the conditions, process, and timelines applicable to the cancellation of Orders placed on the Byte Mart Platform. 1.2 This Cancellation Policy forms an integral part of the Byte Mart Terms and Conditions. In the event of a conflict, this Cancellation Policy shall prevail for matters relating to Order cancellation. 2. Stages of an Order 2.1 For the purpose of this Cancellation Policy, an Order passes through the following stages: (a) Order Placed — the Buyer has placed the Order and payment (if pre-paid) has been authorised; (b) Order Confirmed — Byte Mart has accepted the Order and issued an Order Confirma- tion; (c) Order Packed — the Product has been packed and is awaiting pickup by the logistics partner; (d) Order Dispatched — the Product has been handed over to the logistics partner and is in transit; (e) Out for Delivery — the Product is on the logistics partner’s vehicle for delivery to the Buyer’s address; (f) Delivered — the Product has been delivered to and accepted at the Buyer’s address. 3.
